evals.prompt: Every implementation in this repo that splices a managed block into AGENTS.md must carry a --selftest, and it must pass.
evals.expected_output: Assertion-class case. Discovers every AGENTS.md splice implementation under skills/ by its head/tail surgery (not by filename), then requires each to expose --selftest and to exit 0 when run. A splice that exists without one FAILS this case — that absence, not a wrong check, is how all four copies shipped the same defect.

evals.prompt: Splice every managed block into one AGENTS.md, then splice each again. The file must not change on the second pass.
evals.expected_output: Cross-skill case. Drives all four splice implementations against one AGENTS.md and asserts exactly one blank line between adjacent managed blocks, byte-stability when each is re-applied, and that the repo's own prose above and below survives byte-identical.

evals.prompt: Un-declare this repo from the cross-repo graph manifest. Only that block may disappear.
evals.expected_output: Data-loss case. register-cross-repo-graph's removal path used to return the head and discard every byte after its end marker, so un-declaring a repo deleted the handoff routing block below it. Asserts removal restores the file to exactly its pre-splice bytes and leaves sibling blocks intact.

evals.prompt: Wire this repo for both the knowledge graph and the handoff board, then run each installer again.
evals.expected_output: Integration case. Runs setup-graph-hooks and setup-handoff for real into one isolated repo, asserts both blocks land with exactly one blank line between them, and that a second run of each leaves AGENTS.md byte-identical. Skipped when a prerequisite (git, bash) is unavailable.
